about: The C and C++ sources of freedom-colibrid's native Colibri build, with their licenses (design 0014, Licenses). scripts/colibri-license-gate.py fails on a compiled source or listed header whose SPDX identifier isn't in spdx, and on any that names PolyForm.

components.name: Colibri Stateless
components.note: src/server/ is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 or commercial; the build compiles and includes none of it, nor src/chains/eth/server/ or the prover

components.name: blst
components.note: compiled by its own build script, outside CMake's compile commands: the gate checks its tree's LICENSE

components.name: evmone
components.note: linked while the build keeps the call verifier (0014, The call verifier)

polyform_mentions.why: MIT; c4_print_version prints the server's license text, and only the server and the CLIs call it (0014, Licenses)
